## ServerInstance.start() method

Start the server.

**Signature:**

```typescript
start(): Promise<void>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

## Remarks

Resolves once the listener is accepting connections, so `url` is reachable when it resolves. Rejects when the listener cannot bind (for example, when the port is in use).
